subtitle: Grey ash at the edge of the Wasting, where the Ash-Walkers hold the Eastern Ridge
canonNote: Canon (book1 ch.20): the Ash-Walkers live along the Wasting and fight the Weave-Eaters with Salt of the First Sea; Chieftain Grohl and Mother Vane, the Salt-Speaker, lead them from an enclave in the deep caves of the Eastern Ridge, across a plain of petrified ash. The Cult of Ash (Torvyn Embercloak, Vorn) and its iron-wired bone masks are canon (book1 ch.10, series_bible.md); the purple tear is the later House of Ash's symbol (series_bible.md), used here early (GAME-ONLY). The books also call Torvyn's cultists 'Ashwalkers'; the game keeps the Ash-Walkers of ch.20 and the Cult of Ash apart. The canon Ashlands take their full form after the Spoke fires (series_bible.md), so this pre-erasure rim is PROVISIONAL. GAME-ONLY: the zone's name and its roads to the Peaks and Oakhaven, the cult shrine's location, Cinderfold, the old ribcage, the ash hounds, the brood, and all placement. Grown to 360 m (2026-09-30): the Silent Statue is a canon kind (faceless monoliths in the Wasting, world_bible.md), placed here GAME-ONLY. GAME-ONLY: Wain's Rest and the old salt road, the Last Orchard, the Drowned Leviathan (harpoons of petrified leviathan bone are canon), the Walled Mouth, the Ash Pit and its Ash-Deacon, the Fraying, the Reach-Stones and the Hunters' Knoll.
worldMapNote: Placed at the northern edge of the Ashlands on the game map, south of Oakhaven; exact spot provisional.
objectives: Find the Ash-Walker enclave on the Eastern Ridge
Earn the Salt of the First Sea

exits.name: Ridge road to the Shattered Peaks
Old west road over the mountains to the Verdant Shore (11-13)

wasting.note: Canon: the Wasting unmakes rather than destroys; the Ash-Walkers live along its edge (book1 ch.20).

landmarks.name: Ash-Walker enclave
landmarks.text: Caves in the Eastern Ridge, with water that does not taste of ash.

landmarks.name: The Unwoven Flats
landmarks.text: The ash here is too smooth, as if something licked it clean.

landmarks.name: Tear-marked shrine
landmarks.text: Bone wired to bone, and a purple tear daubed over all of it.

landmarks.name: The old ribcage
landmarks.text: Ribs of something vast, turned to stone before anyone could name it.

landmarks.name: Cinderfold
landmarks.text: A hamlet the grey went through. The houses stayed.

landmarks.name: The brood
landmarks.text: Where the Eaters grow fat at the Wasting's edge.

landmarks.name: The Wasting
landmarks.text: Past the Ridge the world simply stops.

landmarks.name: Wain's Rest
landmarks.text: The last waystation on the old salt road. The wains stopped coming, and then so did everything else.
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the waystation, the salt road and its wains. The grey that unmakes is CANON (world_bible.md).

landmarks.name: The Last Orchard
landmarks.text: Apple trees grey to the root. Nothing here rots: there is nothing left to do the rotting.

landmarks.name: The Drowned Leviathan
landmarks.text: A spine as long as a village street breaks out of the ash and dives back under. The ash was sea, once.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Ash-Walker harpoons of petrified leviathan bone, and a beast of the First Era turned to grey stone on the ash plain, are CANON (book1 ch.20); this leviathan and the old sea are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Ash Pit
landmarks.text: Where the bone-masks kneel, and burn what they take, and kneel again in what is left.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash and its iron-wired bone masks are CANON (book1 ch.10); the pit and its Ash-Deacon are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Walled Mouth
landmarks.text: An Ash-Walker cave the old ones walled up, stone on stone, with salt packed into every gap. The tusks over the door are older than the wall.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Ash-Walkers live in caves along the Wasting and bind Weave-Eaters with salt (book1 ch.20); this cave, and why it was walled, are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Fraying
landmarks.text: A grey tongue of the unmade, licking in behind the Ridge. The Eaters rise out of it like breath on cold glass.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Weave-Eaters born of the Weave's frayed threads are CANON (book1 ch.20); the Fraying is GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Silent Statue
landmarks.text: A lone stone, taller than a house, standing where the grey begins. The Ash-Walkers say it had a face once, and the grey took that first.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Statues, giant faceless monoliths scattered in the Wasting, are CANON (world_bible.md); this one and its place are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Hunters' Knoll
landmarks.text: A knoll the Ash-Walker hunters lie up on to watch the plain for Eaters. They leave the hide standing for whoever needs it.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Ash-Walkers hunt the Weave-Eaters (book1 ch.20); the knoll and its hide are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Reach-Stones
landmarks.text: A stone for every year, set where the grey stopped. Each row stands a little further west than the last.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Wasting creeping on and erasing the world (world_bible.md) and the Ash-Walkers who remained at its edge (book1 ch.20) are CANON; the stones are GAME-ONLY.

camps.canonStatus: CANON faction (Cult of Ash, book1 ch.10), GAME-ONLY placement

secrets.name: The Salt Line
secrets.text: A line of salt runs across the gap in the Ridge, laid fresh and often by the look of it. Past it the ash goes on a little way, and then it doesn't.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Ash-Walkers binding Weave-Eaters with salt is CANON (book1 ch.20); the salt line across the gap is GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: An Ash-Walker Cache
secrets.prompt: Open the salt-crusted bundle between the rocks
secrets.text: A bundle crusted white with salt, tucked between two stones in the lee of the great rock: an Ash-Walker hunters' cache, left for any of their own caught out at dusk. The red cord knotted round it means take what you need.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Ash-Walker harpoons of petrified leviathan bone are CANON (book1 ch.20); the hunters' caches are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: A Cultist's Hidden Letter
secrets.prompt: Work the letter out of the wall
secrets.text: Pushed into a gap in the cult hut's wall, where the others wouldn't look: a letter, with a little money folded in it for the road. Someone meant to run.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash, its bone masks and Vorn are CANON (book1 ch.10, world_bible.md); the letter and its writer are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: Last-Light
secrets.text: Pale flowers pushing up through the ash among the dead snags, faintly lit, the only living thing for a mile. The Ash-Walkers call it last-light and say it grows where something refused to be unmade.

secrets.name: The Cinderfold Tin
secrets.prompt: Scrape the ash back from the tin
secrets.text: A tin buried shallow among the dead trees of Cinderfold's orchard, where some animal has scraped the ash back. Whoever buried it meant to come back once the grey had passed. The grey did not pass.

secrets.name: A Page from the Waybook
secrets.prompt: Ease the page out of the cracked wall
secrets.text: A page torn out of the waystation's waybook and pushed into a crack in the back wall, as if whoever kept the book meant someone to find it. Nobody came along the road to find it.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: Wain's Rest, its waybook and the salt road. The copper taste of the grey's dust is CANON (book1 ch.20).

secrets.name: A Bone-Carver's Bundle
secrets.prompt: Lift the flat stone in the lee of the rib
secrets.text: Under a flat stone in the lee of a great rib, an Ash-Walker carver's bundle: harpoon blanks roughed out of the leviathan's bone, a coil of amber cord, and a charm of leviathan tooth, finished and never collected.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Ash-Walker harpoons of petrified leviathan bone are CANON (book1 ch.20); the carver, the bundle and the charm are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: Last-Light in the Grey
secrets.text: A few pale bells in the ash below the standing stone, faintly lit, with the grey already in the ground all round them. The Ash-Walkers say last-light grows where something refused to be unmade. Here it has company.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Statues, faceless monoliths in the Wasting, are CANON (world_bible.md); last-light and this patch are GAME-ONLY.

stations.name: Mother Vane's salt-bench
stations.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: Mother Vane is CANON (book1 ch.20); her bench is invented.
